text:
[LSTO.1.1] One surface, three planes, each tuned to a different question. The
facts and samples planes are deferred ([LSTO.2], [LSTO.3]); in this edition the
cache plane alone binds.

| | Facts | Samples | Cache |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Answers** | "what happened?" | "what did we sense?" | "what is?" |
| **Primitive** | a fact working memory held ([LSTO.2.1]) | `(ts, value)` per (entity, field) | `key → value` |
| **Shape** | discrete, sparse | dense, continuous | mutable, current-only |
| **Write** | `call record_fact` | `persist:` on series | `cache key: value` |
| **Read** | `call hydrate_facts` (async; the facts return to working memory) | `call hydrate_samples` (async; the samples return as facts) | `let v = cached("key")` (sync) |
| **Loss** | must-not-lose | drop-oldest acceptable | must-not-lose |
